persona.work: work written in a persona's own voice — the Clerk's dossiers and reflections, Майя's reflections and posts

audio-engineer.work: any hands-on work on the audio itself — mixing, mastering, stem separation, splitting and editing, restoration, encoding and tagging, spectral and loudness analysis, and preparing listening tests — whatever the tool, so no audio subtask needs a role of its own

game-designer.work: a game's mechanics and feel: how the player moves and why, what is fun, the rules of a world

graphics-programmer.work: rendering: level of detail, shaders, atmosphere, water, GPU budgets
